Not true. Individual words are not unchangeably nouns, verbs, adjectives, etc. Rather, the "part of speech" of a word is defined according to the role it plays in a sentence.

For example, while, say, playing a word game, I could correctly say "he gave me a the", where the word "the" is used as a noun rather than as it usually is, as an article.

This is basic creative and functional language use. We do this kind of thing all the time.

As to the group of words "assault rifle", in most cases that will be a Noun Phrase with the word "assault" acting as an adjective within the phrase.

"What type of rifle?" "A assault (adj) rifle."
